lines.zh: 卷壳一伸一缩，我顶着水往前推。
lines.en: My coiled shell pumps, pushing me through the water.

lines.zh: 触手排成扇，我把海水推向身后。
lines.en: My tentacles fan out and shove the sea behind me.

lines.zh: 白垩纪的暗流，我认得这条路。
lines.en: These Cretaceous currents — I know this road.

lines.zh: 壳沉甸甸的，游起来像背着石头。
lines.en: My shell is heavy; swimming feels like hauling stone.

lines.zh: 我贴着海床滑，避开上头的浪。
lines.en: I skim the seabed, steering clear of the swell.

lines.zh: 一条小鱼游过，我不急着追。
lines.en: A small fish slips by; I don't hurry after it.

lines.zh: 卷进螺层的水，慢慢吐了出去。
lines.en: Water trapped in my whorls seeps slowly back out.

lines.zh: 每道壳脊都在切水，推我向前。
lines.en: Every ridge on my shell cuts water, driving me on.

lines.zh: 我把身子横过来，钻过石缝。
lines.en: I turn sideways and slip between the rocks.

lines.zh: 深处的冷，比洋面舒服多了。
lines.en: The cold down here feels better than the surface.

lines.zh: 触手尖碰了碰海草，往前挪。
lines.en: My tentacle tips brush the kelp and I move on.

lines.zh: 欧洲古海的那片泥，就在前头。
lines.en: That old European mud is just ahead.

lines.zh: 我慢慢转圈，把水搅成漩涡。
lines.en: I turn slowly, twisting the water into a swirl.

lines.zh: 壳口呼出一串泡，算是打招呼。
lines.en: A string of bubbles leaves my shell mouth by way of greeting.

lines.zh: 别靠太近，我的壳会撞到你。
lines.en: Not too close — my shell will knock into you.

lines.zh: 越往下越暗，我反而安心。
lines.en: The deeper and darker it gets, the calmer I am.

lines.zh: 一条鱼影掠过，我慢半拍才转身。
lines.en: A fish shadow passes; I turn a beat too late.

lines.zh: 海水把我荡开，我又摆了回来。
lines.en: The sea drifts me aside and I sway right back.

lines.zh: 我悬在水里，听远处鲸落的声音。
lines.en: I hang in the water, listening to a distant whale fall.

lines.zh: 卷壳里全是回声，闷闷的。
lines.en: My coiled shell is all muffled echo.

lines.zh: 触手舒开，像一朵慢开的花。
lines.en: My tentacles unfurl like a slow blossom.

lines.zh: 我等一群鱼自己游进圈里。
lines.en: I wait for a school of fish to swim into my reach.

lines.zh: 白垩纪的阳光，隔水也照得到我。
lines.en: Cretaceous sunlight still finds me through the water.

lines.zh: 壳上落了几粒沙，我懒得抖。
lines.en: Sand settles on my shell; I can't be bothered to shake it.

lines.zh: 像鹦鹉螺，又比它老得多。
lines.en: Like a nautilus, but far older.

lines.zh: 我数着水流的节拍，一下一下。
lines.en: I count the current's beat, one pulse at a time.

lines.zh: 安静时，我能听见壳在响。
lines.en: In the quiet I can hear my own shell creak.

lines.zh: 白垩纪的螺壳，沉在海底。
lines.en: A Cretaceous shell, sunk to the seabed.

lines.zh: 一口水咽下去，凉到壳底。
lines.en: I swallow a mouthful of water, cold down to the shell.

lines.zh: 五亿年里，安静是常态。
lines.en: For ages, quiet has been the norm.

lines.zh: 触手缩回去，只留一根探路。
lines.en: My tentacles draw in, leaving one out to feel the way.

lines.zh: 泡沫浮上去，我不追。
lines.en: Bubbles rise; I let them go.

lines.zh: 你不是鱼，我却不知道该不该动。
lines.en: You're no fish, and I don't know whether to move.

lines.zh: 两只手两只脚，水里还站得住？
lines.en: Two hands, two feet — and you stand in water?

lines.zh: 我盯着你，触手不自觉地收紧。
lines.en: I stare at you, tentacles drawing in without meaning to.

lines.zh: 你的影子投到壳上，我看见了。
lines.en: Your shadow falls across my shell; I see it.

lines.zh: 这么直的东西，海床上从没有过。
lines.en: Nothing so straight ever stood on this seabed.

lines.zh: 你看我做什么？我不好看。
lines.en: Why stare? I'm not much to look at.

lines.zh: 我慢慢转过来，让壳朝你。
lines.en: I turn slowly, presenting my shell toward you.

lines.zh: 你要抓我？先追得上这股水流。
lines.en: Want to catch me? Keep up with this current first.

lines.zh: 我认得活物，却不认得你这模样。
lines.en: I know living things, but not a shape like yours.

lines.zh: 别敲我的壳，里面很吵。
lines.en: Don't knock on my shell; it's noisy in there.

lines.zh: 壳上多了一道，我心疼。
lines.en: Another mark on my shell — that stings.

lines.zh: 触手缩回来，半天不敢伸。
lines.en: My tentacles pull in and stay in a long while.

lines.zh: 水里全是我的墨，看不清了。
lines.en: My ink clouds the water; I can't see.

lines.zh: 别打壳，里面全是肉。
lines.en: Don't hit the shell; it's all flesh inside.

lines.zh: 我往深处沉，越深壳越安全。
lines.en: I sink deeper; the deeper the safer for my shell.

lines.zh: 疼得我螺层都缩紧了。
lines.en: The pain pulls my whorls tight.

lines.zh: 这一下，我游得慢了一半。
lines.en: That blow halved my speed.

lines.zh: 我只是条老菊石，别打我。
lines.en: I'm just an old ammonite — leave me be.

lines.zh: 触手断了一截，会再长吧？
lines.en: A tentacle tip is gone; will it grow back?

lines.zh: 我躲进石缝，装成一块石头。
lines.en: I squeeze into a crevice and pass for stone.

lines.zh: 鱿鱼的气味？我触手先动了。
lines.en: Squid in the water? My tentacles moved first.

lines.zh: 那条鱼在晃，我忍不住想伸。
lines.en: That fish wriggles and I can't help reaching.

lines.zh: 食鱼性是我的老习惯，改不了。
lines.en: Eating fish is an old habit I can't break.

lines.zh: 嗅觉顺着水流过来，太近了。
lines.en: The scent rides the current, far too close.

lines.zh: 我慢一点，免得吓跑这顿。
lines.en: I'll go slowly so the meal doesn't bolt.

lines.zh: 触手已经自己卷过去了。
lines.en: My tentacles have already coiled toward it.

lines.zh: 别在我壳口晃，我会咬。
lines.en: Don't dangle at my shell mouth; I will bite.

lines.zh: 这一口，够我安静好几天。
lines.en: One bite like this keeps me quiet for days.

lines.zh: 水和鳞片的味道，混在一起。
lines.en: Water and scales, the smells running together.

lines.zh: 我探出半个头，又缩了回去。
lines.en: I poke half out, then sink back again.

lines.zh: 硬壳撞上去，闷得我发晕。
lines.en: My hard shell knocks and my head rings.

lines.zh: 哎呀，我没长眼睛看那边。
lines.en: Oops — I wasn't looking that way.

lines.zh: 壳和我一样，都不是软东西。
lines.en: Shell and whatever that was, neither is soft.

lines.zh: 这一下把我推出好几格。
lines.en: That shoved me back several blocks.

lines.zh: 水流把我推歪了，不怪我。
lines.en: The current steered me off course, not my fault.

lines.zh: 我退开后，壳上还留着声。
lines.en: I back off, but the clang still hangs on my shell.

lines.zh: 别挤，我的壳经不起裂。
lines.en: Don't crowd me; this shell can't take a crack.

lines.zh: 撞一下，我倒安心没碎。
lines.en: One knock, and I'm relieved nothing broke.

lines.zh: 两个大东西，总有一个先让。
lines.en: With two big things, one always gives way.

lines.zh: 我绕开你，慢慢漂过去。
lines.en: I'll go around you and drift on by.

lines.zh: 卷壳对上卷壳，就算成了。
lines.en: Shell to shell, and that's settled.

lines.zh: 水里很静，我们只转圈。
lines.en: The water is still; we just circle.

lines.zh: 一样的螺纹，转起来正好。
lines.en: Matching whorls, turning in step.

lines.zh: 我放慢动作，怕碰坏它的壳。
lines.en: I slow down so I don't crack its shell.

lines.zh: 两只菊石，像一对旧陶器。
lines.en: Two ammonites, like a pair of old pots.

lines.zh: 触手交叠，比说话更省事。
lines.en: Tentacles overlapping says more than words.

lines.zh: 它转得比我稳，我跟着它。
lines.en: It turns steadier than I do, so I follow.

lines.zh: 海水暖了一点，大概是这个季节。
lines.en: The water's warmer — must be the season.

lines.zh: 这场相会，能持续好几个潮。
lines.en: This courtship can last several tides.

lines.zh: 转过身，我们就各游各的。
lines.en: We turn away and each swims off.

lines.zh: 一小块贝壳，我收进触手里。
lines.en: A little shell fragment — I tuck it up in my tentacles.

lines.zh: 海草缠上来，我随手扯开。
lines.en: Kelp snags on me; I tug it loose.

lines.zh: 这东西能吃？闻着不像。
lines.en: Is this edible? Doesn't smell like it.

lines.zh: 沉下来的碎骨，我推着走。
lines.en: A sunken bone shard; I push it along.

lines.zh: 我拿壳口兜住，怕它再掉。
lines.en: I scoop it against my shell mouth so it won't drop.

lines.zh: 一粒亮石子，比鱼有意思。
lines.en: A bright pebble — more interesting than fish.

lines.zh: 不是鱼，但我还是捡了。
lines.en: Not fish, but I pick it up anyway.

lines.zh: 这小东西硌在触手里，怪舒服。
lines.en: It presses into my tentacles in a pleasing way.

lines.zh: 我把它含住，慢慢往壳里塞。
lines.en: I hold it and slowly stuff it into the shell.

lines.zh: 海床上总有些没用的宝贝。
lines.en: There's always useless treasure on the seabed.

lines.zh: 鱼！触手已经先我一步了。
lines.en: Fish! My tentacles got there before I did.

lines.zh: 那一小团银光，归我了。
lines.en: That little gleam of silver is mine.

lines.zh: 我锁定了，就不再松开。
lines.en: Once fixed, I don't let go.

lines.zh: 食鱼的念头一上来就压不住。
lines.en: The hunger for fish rises and won't be pressed down.

lines.zh: 别游了，你跑不过我的壳。
lines.en: Stop swimming; you can't outrun my shell.

lines.zh: 我调整了螺层，准备扑上去。
lines.en: I settle my whorls and prepare to lunge.

lines.zh: 这顿晚饭，我盯了很久。
lines.en: I've had my eye on this supper a long while.

lines.zh: 触手张开，圈住前面那片水。
lines.en: Tentacles spread, closing off the water ahead.

lines.zh: 味儿对了，就是你了。
lines.en: Scent's right — it's you.

lines.zh: 我不快，但我够准。
lines.en: I'm not fast, but I'm precise.

lines.zh: 还差一点，我耐心等。
lines.en: A little closer; I'll wait.

lines.zh: 它往左，我就把壳拨向左。
lines.en: It goes left, so I steer my shell left.

lines.zh: 我没变方向，一直在跟着。
lines.en: I haven't turned away; I'm still following.

lines.zh: 卷壳转得很慢，可不会停。
lines.en: My coiled shell turns slowly, but never stops.

lines.zh: 这片水域，已经缩成一条线。
lines.en: The hunting ground narrows to a single line.

lines.zh: 它慌起来，反而更好抓。
lines.en: Its panic only makes it easier.

lines.zh: 我算着距离，等它进圈。
lines.en: I measure the gap, waiting for it to enter.

lines.zh: 我卷起的壳已经挡在它前面。
lines.en: My coiled shell is already in its path.

lines.zh: 我的呼吸和它的摆尾同拍。
lines.en: My breathing keeps time with its tail.

lines.zh: 再近一格，触手就够得着。
lines.en: One more block and my tentacles reach.

lines.zh: 触手抽出去，卷住了！
lines.en: My tentacle lashes out and catches it!

lines.zh: 壳口一张，咬得又闷又实。
lines.en: My shell mouth opens for a dull, solid bite.

lines.zh: 我拖住它，往壳里拉。
lines.en: I grip it and drag it toward my shell.

lines.zh: 这一卷，够它挣半天。
lines.en: One coil like this and it'll struggle for a while.

lines.zh: 别怪我不讲道理，饿了。
lines.en: Don't blame me for being unreasonable — I'm hungry.

lines.zh: 触手勒紧，水都被挤开。
lines.en: My tentacles tighten and the water squeezes out.

lines.zh: 咬住就不放，这是我唯一会的。
lines.en: Bite and hold — it's the only thing I know.

lines.zh: 它撞在壳上，我顺势一夹。
lines.en: It hits my shell and I clamp down on the rebound.

lines.zh: 疼吗？我其实没什么力气。
lines.en: Does it hurt? I'm not really that strong.

lines.zh: 这一口下去，水里见了红。
lines.en: One bite, and the water turns red.

lines.zh: 我从白垩纪的暗水里浮上来。
lines.en: I rise out of the Cretaceous dark.

lines.zh: 卷壳先出水，然后是触手。
lines.en: My coiled shell emerges first, then the tentacles.

lines.zh: 欧洲古海的泥，还粘着我。
lines.en: Mud from the old European sea still clings to me.

lines.zh: 这么亮的地方，我有点不习惯。
lines.en: So much light here; I'm not used to it.

lines.zh: 水流告诉我，这是新的一片海。
lines.en: The current tells me this is a new sea.

lines.zh: 我慢慢展开，像一枚活的螺旋。
lines.en: I unfurl slowly, a living spiral.

lines.zh: 菊石回来了，隔了六千万年。
lines.en: An ammonite returns, sixty million years late.

lines.zh: 壳里的水还没排空，等等。
lines.en: My shell's still draining; give me a moment.

lines.zh: 鱼呢？我一睁眼就在找鱼。
lines.en: Where are the fish? I woke up looking for them.

lines.zh: 这地方的水，比记忆里浅。
lines.en: This water is shallower than I remember.

lines.zh: 我转了一圈，总算认得方位。
lines.en: One turn, and I finally know which way is which.

lines.zh: 别怕，我只想安安静静游着。
lines.en: Don't be afraid; I only want to swim in peace.

lines.zh: 水被烧热了，壳烫得发白。
lines.en: The water boils and my shell scalds white.

lines.zh: 我从高处摔下，壳磕出裂。
lines.en: I drop from a height and my shell cracks.

lines.zh: 我本来住水里，怎么会淹？
lines.en: I live in water — how am I drowning?

lines.zh: 气浪撕开我的卷壳，露出软肉。
lines.en: The blast tears my coiled shell open to the soft flesh.

lines.zh: 一支箭扎进螺层，拔不出来。
lines.en: An arrow is lodged in my whorls and won't come out.

lines.zh: 紫色的光钻进壳缝，很疼。
lines.en: Violet light seeps into the seams of my shell.

lines.zh: 太久没吃到鱼，壳都轻了。
lines.en: Too long without fish; my shell feels hollow.

lines.zh: 雷劈进水里，我整个麻了。
lines.en: Lightning struck the water and numbed all of me.

lines.zh: 我的卷壳沉得很，浮不起来。
lines.en: My coiled shell is heavy and will not float.
